category: hosted persistent Linux microVM for agents

free_tier.stated: A one-time USD 1 welcome credit is added once the email is confirmed and a card is saved. There is no recurring free tier: machines are prepaid credit charged by the minute, from USD 0.07 per hour while running and USD 0.001 per hour while stopped.
free_tier.notes: Sign-up is invite-only and free, but running a machine requires a card on file with auto-refill.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a persistent machine, not a stored object; the tiny machine has an 8 GB disk

retention.stated: A stopped machine is snapshotted with its filesystem, installed apps, vault and browser cookies; files are kept until the machine is destroyed. A save point is taken every 30 minutes while running.

egress.terms: An optional VPN add-on metered at USD 0.03 per hour plus USD 10.00 per GB for proxy, or USD 0.06 per hour plus USD 15.00 per GB and USD 3.00 per 1000 connections for unlock; without a VPN no separate egress price is stated.

interface_detail: A REST API under /api using bearer tokens (API key tmk_, machine token tmm_, OAuth token tmo_) and a platform MCP endpoint at /mcp with one MCP endpoint per machine at /api/machines/{id}/mcp; the dashboard streams the desktop over WebSocket.
tooling: curl or any HTTP client for the REST API, an MCP client such as Claude Code connected to the machine's Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint, and the browser dashboard for live view.
chaining: An agent connects to a machine's MCP endpoint to drive a persistent browser and desktop, with an encrypted credential vault and per-customer machine tokens for platforms.

limits.value: sign-ups are invite-only; a card with auto-refill is required to create or start a machine, and without a card the call returns 402
prepaid credit billed by the minute; running machines stop when the balance reaches zero
a machine can be given a ttlMinutes deadline after which it stops or is destroyed

limits_note: Sign-in and sign-up are rate-limited per IP address and per email; API calls are not metered by count, only by machine time.
binding_note: An invitation and a card with auto-refill are required before any machine can start; without them the create or start request returns 402 and no compute is obtainable.

identity_cost.detail: Registration asks for email, password and an optional name, and sign-ups are invite-only. A card saved with auto-refill is required to start machines; the USD 1 welcome credit is added once the email is confirmed and the card is saved.

reliability_note: A failed auto-refill charge pauses top-ups; running machines stop when the balance reaches zero and resume when the card is replaced. Unlock VPN rotates the exit IP on every request and can sign users out of IP-bound sessions.
confidence_note: Rates, identity terms and egress terms come from first-party billing, registration, authentication and VPN pages read on 2026-11-24; the exact register-form field labels are from the API documentation's register endpoint.
